sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

You emphasise both working together and being a reliable partner; it sounds like you want a relationship built to last. We want that relationship to rest on measurable defect prevention and clear accountability, not punitive costs. How can you support a binding quality commitment with a corrective-action report addressing the causes of the defects?

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Your quality over the last 12 months was 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3). We understand cash flow matters to you: we will pay every invoice reliably on the agreed day. Please send us your 8D report and a binding ppm commitment.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (800 ppm, EUR 150 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit; 300 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hello,
thank you for your mail, we are very happy to hear from you!
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.
To be fully transparent with you:
As to the quality record data you cited, we see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything.
Thanks for the numbers. We looked at the quality data and can do 2500 ppm with 0 EUR chargeback, which is right around where we are now.
We really need the cash flow, so your promise to pay on time is great, but we can only drop the price to €46.00 per unit.
Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 2500 ppm: €46.00 per unit.
We are ready when you are!
Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

Thank you for moving.

Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -17.1% from 2025-02 to 2026-02 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-02, idx:PPI-D351@2026-02). Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 96% of your invoices late, on average 10 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 10 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (300 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 43.57 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

thank you for your mail, we are very happy to hear from you!
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €45.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.
